Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage Pricing

Pay-as-you-go storage is $6.95/TB/month. The first 10GB storage is free.

Class A, B, and C transactions are free. Class D transactions are $0.004 per 10,000 after the first 2,500 per day.

Egress is free up to 3x average monthly storage, then $0.01/GB.

B2 Overdrive is $15/TB/month with unlimited egress.

No minimum file size or duration.
